text: Criterion `ac-wpis-rejestru-kontekstow-dla-brief-ni` says the brief thread's lack of filesystem built-ins comes from the turn's group gating driven by `agent.disableDirectFilesystemAccess` (not from the context registry), and that `Read` exists on the diff-explore subagent surface only when that flag is unchecked. M21 Context Types (m21ctxreg, 2.1.13) declares for `brief` "− wszystkie built-iny — `Read` włącznie" and diff-explore with release-tools only, and the code agrees: the registry row's `builtinTools: 'none'` makes `resolveAgentToolGroups` deny file-read/file-write/shell whatever the flag says, and diff-explore names no built-in at all (2.1.5). Assumed m21ctxreg: the test for the criterion asserts what both agree on — no filesystem built-ins on a brief thread, denied as tool groups of the turn (the registry declares no deny groups), diff-explore without Read, the content delivered in-memory by get_brief — and asserts the denial holds with the flag on AND off. Suggest rewording the criterion (or deprecating it) to match m21ctxreg.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0005 — the criterion says the mechanism is the flag alone and that diff-explore has Read with the flag unchecked; M21 m21ctxreg (2.1.13) strips every built-in from a brief thread, Read included
